name: overgrowth_road
subject_label: a convoy on a reclaimed road

default: cracked asphalt buckled by root growth
the rusted shell of an abandoned vehicle half-swallowed by vines
a collapsed overpass looming ahead, choked with vegetation
faded road signs leaning at odd angles
a canopy of reclaimed growth closing overhead
post_apocalyptic: a stripped fuel drum lashed to the lead vehicle
a hand-painted marker warning of the route ahead
scavenged tires stacked as makeshift barriers

situations.text: clearing fallen debris blocking the road ahead
scouting a collapsed structure just off the road
making a roadside repair before the light fails
foraging along the overgrown roadside for anything useful
ambushed from the treeline without warning
sharing a meal around a low fire as dusk settles
pushing on as a storm closes over the road
keeping a quiet watch at the edge of the convoy
